projectState.summary: Byte E3a is implemented in the clean temp worktree on top of E2 and includes Arne's follow-up UX fix for stronger interaction feedback. The Ear Check overlay supports a focused listening-vote experiment with deterministic A/B takes: A = bass answers melody with color off, B = bass answers melody with color on. Vote buttons persist song.interplay_vote records with song identity, active/selected take ids, take definitions, answer count, current enabled/color state, and last-answer summary. The UI now has a progress strip (A pass, B pass, Vote), a high-contrast status banner, and strong Vote recorded completion copy; older quick feedback controls remain under a Diagnostics lid. window.interplay exposes applyTake(), vote(), and getExperiment() with takes/votes/progress. This is UI/instrumentation only: no scheduler/audio/harmony/scorer/evolution/model path changed. Validation: build green; focused interplay smoke green 1/1; full smoke green 79/79 after feedback update; diff-check green. npm audit remains red on pre-existing esbuild/Vite advisories.
